repos_data.description: Make it a fun to create spec for developers and teammates

Open-source (AGPL-3.0) PDF takeoff for construction & flooring — the first engine an AI agent drives natively over MCP, not bolted on. Rooms measured on the wall faces, symbol sweeps, materials + quantities with full provenance, built for preconstruction. Runs entirely in your browser.
An expansible unit conversion library for .NET: exact definitions, synonym-based unit names and no dependencies.

Unit converter for AI agents, powered by the GNU units database — convert 3000+ units of measurement, evaluate compound unit expressions, reduce to SI base units, dimensional analysis. Offline, deterministic.
Measures what actually happens to established TCP and UDP connections when a Kubernetes pod terminates. Every claim traceable to a committed report.
Exchange WebSocket wire measurement: frame/control-frame accounting, payload-vs-wire ratios, compression negotiation, and a documented API-contract audit.
